Name: Lunartique's Fisharia Anime Portraits
Author: Lunartique07
Description:
[b]Notice:
[/b]I made this mod since I wanted to use this portrait mod for 1.6 and didn't expect anyone else to try to make a 1.6 version.
But I'm not an artist, Manch made their own version, and I think they did it better, check out their version here:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21356]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21356[/url][b]

[/b]I don't plan on making any updates to this mod, but I'll keep it up in case anyone prefers it.[b]

Information:
[/b]FIsharia's anime portraits mod updated to version 1.6, as well as new winter outfit portraits made by me.
[b]
Bachelorettes and Bachelors:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/n0YGptN.png[/img]

Other Characters:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/q2ijcl2.png[/img]

Download:
[/b]1. Download and set-up [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].[b]
[/b]2. Download and extract this mod.
3. Paste the folder "Lunartique's Fisharia Anime Portraits" to "...\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods".[b]

Credits: (Permission was acquired from Flat Fish to create this mod.)[/b]
